name: ai-prompt-flow
title: AI Prompt Flow
description: A full prompt-to-answer scene: the prompt types itself, the button runs to loading, a skeleton shimmers, the answer crossfades in and a toast confirms.
useWhen: Demoing an AI product's whole prompt-to-answer experience in one self-contained scene.
Showing the generation lifecycle end to end: typing, loading, answer reveal, confirmation toast.
A product walkthrough needs a polished AI workflow beat with no custom timing work.
avoidWhen: You only need a button press with a loading state: use button.
You only need a field that types: use input.
You need custom orchestration across scenes: compose the primitives yourself.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Prompt
variables.description: Text typed into the prompt field.

variables.label: Answer lines
variables.description: JSON array of answer lines revealed at the end.
variables.default: ["The thread debates the Q3 roadmap: ship the editor first,", "defer billing to Q4, and pull the migration forward so", "infra is unblocked before the team scales next quarter."]

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
